intentionalChanges.field: Updated for B24 floor-based signed integer sampling; seeded changes approved by user. Then: Brush dots and stamps are now generated on the GPU from hashed randomness: same distribution and ink (within ~2% of 2.3.0), different seeded realization. Approved by user 2026-10-27. Then: density-invariant dot footprint (F01); these scenes render at density 1, where fine brushes are now ~4x lighter, matching density 2. Then: strokes are drawn on the default paper tooth (strength 0.5), seeded by brush.seed().
